external_collaboration.evidence_quote: Maynooth Post Primary School is a co-educational multi-denominational school with non-selective entry getting the large majority of its students from the primary schools in its catchment area. It opened in 1971 as a vocational school in the grounds of the Presentation convent and moved to the Moyglare Road in 1972 under the auspices of County Kildare Vocational Educational Committee; now Kildare and Wicklow Education and Training Board.
In 2021 the school relocated to its present location at Mariavilla as part of Maynooth Education Campus incorporating MPP, MCC and Gael Scoil Ruairi.
